tools.name: top_decks
tools.description: The most played or highest win-rate Clash Royale decks from recent real battles of top players, with usage and win rate. Use for "best deck", "meta decks", "best Hog Rider deck", "decks without Mega Knight" and similar questions.

tools.name: check_deck
tools.description: Rates an 8-card Clash Royale deck: role checks (win condition, spells, air defense…), how it and similar decks have done in real battles, its matchups against each deck style, and one-card swaps that won more. Write "Evo Knight" or "Knight (Hero)" for those slots.

tools.name: meta_snapshot
tools.description: The current Clash Royale meta from real battles: how popular each deck style is, which styles beat which, and the cards rising or falling in use.

tools.name: player_practice_priorities
tools.description: For a player tag (e.g. #8Q2V0CJL): their record, decks, and up to three matchups to practice, comparing their win rate with similar players in the same matchup. Only works for players Insights Royale already tracks; otherwise returns a link to start tracking.
